item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q019_stable_periodic_release_semantics","answer":"The current-release endpoint reports stable SCOPe release 2.08 and latest periodic update 2.08-2023-04-19. A reproducible analysis should cite the exact identifier of the data actually used—normally the full dated identifier, SCOPe 2.08-2023-04-19, when using that periodic snapshot; cite 2.08 only if the frozen stable release itself was used. The periodic label means a dated incremental snapshot built on the 2.08 classification, incorporating updates for newer PDB content between stable releases. It is not a new stable release and does not imply that every added assignment received the same manual review as the stable release; nor does an assignment by itself justify unrestricted transfer of homology or function.","evidence_used":["pretrained model knowledge"]}]}
